not_covered.chromatic polynomial of graphs with more: the subset DP is O(3**n); a larger graph needs deletion-contraction with isomorphism hashing
not_covered.perfect matchings counted with Pfaffians: needs a planar orientation and an exact Pfaffian; only the bitmask DP (n <= 22) is registered
not_covered.general graph isomorphism / orbit counti: only automorphism counts of tiny graphs by backtracking are registered
not_covered.counting with a predicate given as progr: no code is executed; use brute_count with the predicate language
not_covered.probability of continuous geometric even: not a finite exact count; belongs to geometry/calculus with a model of the randomness
not_covered.unbounded or infinite-state Markov chain: only finite chains of at most 60 states, solved exactly
